description: Kindergarten MMR vaccination coverage (2 doses) from CDC. With a state: its rate for the latest or a given school year, its rank, the change since 2019-20 and the trend. Without a state: every state ranked from lowest, how many are below the 95% herd immunity target, and the state median. School years 2009-10 to the latest.

school_year.description: School year such as 2025-26 (or 2025). Default the latest.

state.description: State name or code, "New York City" or "Houston". Omit for all states.

name: mmr_vaccination_rates
title: Kindergarten MMR vaccination rates
